metadata.question: Was the PM2.5 higher over Wuhan, China in February 2020 than in February 2019?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Need PM2.5 data for Wuhan, China - Compare February 2020 vs February 2019 - Sentinel-5P has aerosol data (aerosol_index_340_380), but not direct PM2.5 - Could use Copernicus Atmosphere Monitoring Service (CAMS) global atmospheric composition forecasts - Or use NO2/AOD as proxy, but the question specifically asks for PM2.5 - Best option: Use Sentinel-5P aerosol optical depth or look for specific PM2.5 datasets - Actually, GEE doesn't have direct PM2.5 measurements. Will need to use proxy like AOD from MODIS or aerosol index from Sentinel-5P 2. Masking strategy: - For atmospheric data, cloud masking is less critical but should filter for quality - Use qa_value filters for Sentinel-5P or QA bands for MODIS 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero from Null/Error: - Valid zero would mean actually low PM2.5/aerosol levels (unlikely to be exactly 0) - Null/Error would be None, NaN, or if no valid pixels exist after filtering - Need to check collection size first, then pixel counts after processing ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // Define Wuhan location const wuhan = ee.Geometry.Point([114.3055, 30.5928]); const region = wuhan.buffer(50000); // 50km radius // Define time periods const feb2019 = ['2019-02-01', '2019-03-01']; const feb2020 = ['2020-02-01', '2020-03-01']; // Use Sentinel-5P Aerosol Index as proxy for PM2.5 // Aerosol Index correlates with particulate matter const collection = 'COPERNICUS/S5P/OFFL/L3_AER_AI'; // Function to filter and process function getAerosolData(dateRange) { const col = ee.ImageCollection(collection) .filterDate(dateRange[0], dateRange[1]) .filterBounds(region) .select('absorbing_aerosol_index'); return col; } // Get collections const col2019 = getAerosolData(feb2019); const col2020 = getAerosolData(feb2020); const size2019 = await col2019.size().getInfo(); const size2020 = await col2020.size().getInfo(); console.log(`2019 Images: ${size2019}`); console.log(`2020 Images: ${size2020}`); // Check if collections are empty if (size2019 === 0 && size2020 === 0) { console.log("No data for both periods."); console.log("C1"); return; } if (size2019 === 0 || size2020 === 0) { console.log("No data for one period."); console.log("C1"); return; } // Calculate mean for each period const mean2019Image = col2019.mean(); const mean2020Image = col2020.mean(); // Reduce to get values const stats2019 = await mean2019Image.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: region, scale: 5000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const stats2020 = await mean2020Image.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: region, scale: 5000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); // Check pixel counts const count2019 = await mean2019Image.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: region, scale: 5000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const count2020 = await mean2020Image.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: region, scale: 5000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const val2019 = stats2019.absorbing_aerosol_index; const val2020 = stats2020.absorbing_aerosol_index; const pixels2019 = count2019.absorbing_aerosol_index; const pixels2020 = count2020.absorbing_aerosol_index; console.log(`2019 Mean AI: ${val2019}, Pixels: ${pixels2019}`); console.log(`2020 Mean AI: ${val2020}, Pixels: ${pixels2020}`); // Check for no valid pixels if (pixels2019 === 0 || pixels2020 === 0) { console.log("No valid pixels after processing."); console.log("C2"); return; } // Check for null/invalid values if (val2019 === null || val2019 === undefined || isNaN(val2019) || val2020 === null || val2020 === undefined || isNaN(val2020)) { console.log("Invalid calculation results."); console.log("C3"); return; } // Compare values - Higher aerosol index means more PM2.5 // Note: During COVID-19 lockdown in Feb 2020, pollution decreased if (val2020 > val2019) { console.log("PM2.5 proxy higher in Feb 2020."); console.log("A"); } else { console.log("PM2.5 proxy lower in Feb 2020."); console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
